tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab bdun mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i phrin las kyi kha 'phang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang dbang bskur ni/1$0000300 gnas gsum zla ba pad+ma dang: nyi mar oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams las: 'od zer rgyal ba thams cad mchod: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus: rnam par snang mdzad 'od dpag med: mi bskyod yab yum sku ru gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swā bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swā bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swā bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: spyi bor rigs lnga yab yum sbyor: chu yis sgrib sbyangs dbang bskur nas: yab yum rigs lngas dbu yang brgyan: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā ā dar+sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā sa ma tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā pra t+ya bek+ṣa ṇa dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā kṛ t+ya nuṣ+ṭhā na dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ:
༈ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa rnams ni/

hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor na: byol song gtso brgyad dregs pa dang: dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan steng na: 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs pa yi: mngon rdzogs rgyal po he ru ka: ye shes rnam rol lha tshogs la: gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti pū ho: hūm̐: dur khrod rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral pa yi: dbang po nang khrol dri nga ba: rnam shes khrag dang sha rus zas: rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra rnams ni: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā puṣ+pe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: gan+dhe: ni bid+yā: shab+da pū dza ho: hūm̐ḥ dug lnga rnam dag sman chen po: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: rmad byung bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐:
mtshan don sbyar zhing dngos grub blang*/

chos sku kun bzang drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// longs sku rnam snang sprul sku rdo rje sems// shākya thub sogs ston pa bcu gnyis la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mngon rdzogs rgyal po yongs 'khyud bde ma yum// rdo rje chos dang las kyi dbang mo che// dha na saṃskṛ pad+ma thod phreng la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhar chen mtsho rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan zhabs// dpal gyi ye shes chos kyi blo gros rje// mchog gyur gling pa rtsa brgyud bla ma la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhi ba rdor dbyings 'bar ba he ru ka /klong dgu'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug gtso dang 'khor// ma mo rbod gtong dkyil 'khor rab 'byams la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun khyab rtag pa'i rgyal mo mu kha le// ye shes las dang 'jig rten tshul gnas pa'i/ snang srid ma mo rol pa'i lha tshogs la// ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// ma hā pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/
bdud rtsi'i lhag ma'i thig le gnas gsum bkod/
kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha:

badz+ra a mṛtaṃ sid+dhi ku ru ṣ+wa me/ hūm̐: lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha ru: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i don snying khrag: dmar chen rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta pū dza khā hi: hūm̐: bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor mar sbyar: 'dod yon rnam lngas rab spras pa: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā ba lin+ta khā hi: hūm̐: bde stong gnyis med rab sbyor zhing: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i tshogs: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: gnyis su med par thim gyur nas: ka dag klong du grol bar shog: ta na ga ṇa ti ra sid+dhi dharma dhā tu pū dza ho:
zhes pa'ang yar stod sham po gangs rar ma mo'i sgrub mdos gtang ba'i tshe gu ṇas zhabs tog tu spel/// /
